headline: Chinese AI Developers Leverage US Models to Train Domestic Competitors
summary: Faced with escalating US hardware export controls, Chinese tech firms are increasingly turning to American AI foundation models to train and optimize domestic competitor systems.
why: Technological decoupling between the US and China forces domestic Chinese developers to seek alternative data and training methodologies to maintain parity in artificial intelligence.

impacts.name: China Technology
impacts.why: Distillation of overseas models enables Chinese developers to circumvent severe hardware constraints.
